correctness.rationale: PASS: With the rightmost occupied site exiting in one update, parallel internal 10-to-01 swaps all act on disjoint adjacent pairs. An internal maximal pre-upstep-height particle must move and drop its preheight by one; if maximizers sit at the exit, a blocked penultimate occupied site provides the survivor at H-1. Every survivor has new preheight at most H-1; the only nonempty state that empties next is 0^(n-1)1 with H=1-n. Thus T=n+H for every nonempty state, including n=1 and all occupied. Reflection of Bernoulli ±1 paths under the running-height barrier gives the stated Q_p binomial formula; telescoping at p=1/2 gives the shells. Negative drift gives finite supremum and geometric gambler ruin law; zero drift Donsker/reflection gives |Z|; positive drift gives M_n-S_n=O_P(1) and binomial CLT. Fresh independent exhaustive synchronous states n=1..12 (8190 total) matched T, shell counts and weighted CDF at odds 1:2 and 2:1; finite tests support but do not replace the all-n proof.
